strings.string: Dovetail
Creates dovetails on a sketch line. Pick a line, then set count / size / depth / tolerance.
Line
Select a sketch line
Count
Mirror geometry

Half the teeth point one way and half the other, arranged so that turning the contour 180 degrees about the midpoint of the line maps it onto itself. Both parts of the cut then come out identical - one file, printed twice, the second one rotated. Needs an even count, the centred split and no offset, so those are set for you.

Moves the teeth along the line by one step. Limited to the range in which they still fit entirely on the line.
Tolerance
The line is
Centre line - half the tolerance each side
Pocket edge - all the tolerance on the pin
Pin edge - all the tolerance on the pocket
Decides which part gives up material for the clearance. Centred keeps two equal halves equal; the other two take the whole tolerance out of one part and leave the other exactly on the line.

The band spans across the line, so the line would cut it into two profiles. As construction geometry it creates no profile but keeps its dimensions and constraints, which deleting it would throw away.
